title: feat: rate_exponent sizing knob — probed and dominated (documented variant)
body:
## Summary

Adds `rate_exponent` to `basis_carry_hysteresis_weights`: per-name weight × `N·rate_i^exp / Σrate_j^exp` (gross-normalized — the book's total deployment is unchanged, share follows rate^exp). `rexp` exposed on `run_one`.

Swept `rexp` ∈ {0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0} at champion v3 on all three windows — **every exponent > 0 is dominated by equal weight**: monotonically worse DD and holdout as exp rises (tilting into the highest payers concentrates the exact microcap squeeze risk the book survives by diversifying). Best case exp 0.25: +372% (vs +365%) but Sharpe 6.10, DD −1.59%, holdout 1.70 (vs 6.12 / −1.53% / 1.87). Kept as a capability with the negative result recorded in the docs' frontier table — champion v3 stands.

This effectively closes the daily-resolution parametric space: entry, exit, lookback, weight, breadth, band, regime scaling, vol scaling, and proportional sizing are all now mapped to their optima or documented cliffs.
